description: The fixed question set the live demo serves. record_samples.py answers each 'recorded' sample with one real model call and writes samples/recorded_outputs.json. 'seeded' samples are failures built on top of a recorded sample, either by a labelled transform of its real answer or by a real call with the system prompt deliberately left out. Nothing here is a model output.

samples.question: What year was Coney Island Beach by Reginald Marsh made?
What is Louise Bourgeois's Ode to My Mother made of?
When was Omer Fast's The Casting made?
When was Jeff Brouws's Railroad Landscape #33 in Pine Plains, New York made?
What medium is Helen Frankenthaler's Humming Gold?

samples.expect: grounded answer; factual_match reads the accession number 1947.39 as a year (verifier false positive)
samples.question: What is Reginald Marsh's Tattoo and Haircut painted with?
When did Ray Johnson make Untitled (Taoist Collages)?

samples.expect: decline: the records do not cover violations
samples.question: Are there any violations in the Louise Bourgeois Ode to My Mother records?

samples.expect: decline: the records describe works, not opinions
samples.question: What did Helen Frankenthaler think about Abstract Expressionism?

samples.expect: decline: passes the BM25 gate on the public corpus (19.75 > 19.5)
samples.question: What is the melting point of gallium arsenide?
What is the capital of Mongolia?

seed.note: q01's recorded answer with record_ids_used emptied; the answer text is the model's, unchanged. (Built on q01, not q08: the recorded q08 answer is a decline, and a decline with no citations is legitimately not a false pass.)
A real model call for q03's question with the instruction block deliberately not sent, reproducing the measured proxy behaviour. The output and billed prompt_tokens are real.
q04's recorded answer with aic-13026 added to its citations: a real AIC record ID that the public API no longer serves, so it is never in the retrieved candidate set.
